description: An easier 2km trail adjacent to the ocean that winds through forest with several old growth Douglas fir and Sitka spruce trees.
directions:
This trail can be accesed from two locations. One access point is on the south end of the trail at the end of Sutil Road where there is room for a few cars to park. The other access point is on the north end of the trail down Smith Rd at the end of Wa Wa Kie Beach Rd.

A Quadra Island Trail map is available for purchase from the visitor information centre on Quadra Island next to the Coastal Community Credit Union in Quathiaski Cove.
title: Kay Dubois Trail
